Maya (eng): Heads-up — guest G. Chen arriving in ~20m. Needs a visitor badge and a quiet spot for a 30m call. Also courier left a box labeled 'Corgi Corner' at reception, not sure what that is.
FrontDeskBot: Delivery notice: 1 package for Maya (2 boxes). Stored at front desk.
Alex (People Ops): Ugh badge printer jam again 😬 — error code `PR-03`. If someone can grab spare lanyards please.
Jordan (facilities): On it. I'll run down with spare badges in 5. Can also check the printer.
Priya (people-ops): I can move the low-traffic table (Table 3) near the plants to the quiet zone. Good for calls.
Kevin (ops): Which box is fragile? Label says "glass — upright" on one of them.
Maya (eng): The small one is fragile — team demo prop. Could someone please bring it to meeting room B? I'll meet them at reception.
Jordan (facilities): I'll grab the fragile box and the spare badges. Also fixed the jam by clearing the roller, but reloading ribbon now.
Alex (People Ops): Reminder — visitor QR is an option but for meeting room access we prefer a physical badge. Priya can pre-fill the badge with 'Guest — G. Chen'.
Priya (people-ops): Done. Badge printed and labeled. Putting it in "visitor" tray.
FrontDeskBot: Visitor G. Chen checked in at 15:12. Badge assigned: Guest - G. Chen.
Maya (eng): Thank you!! Quick poll: where should they sit? 1) Table 3 (quiet) 2) Sofa in lounge 3) Quiet room (booking)
Alex (People Ops): 3) Quiet room — will book for 30m and leave a note. :thumbsup:
Jordan (facilities): 1) works for overflow if quiet room is full.
Kevin (ops): Also FYI 'Corgi Corner' is a potted ficus we keep by the windows. Someone labeled it as a joke and that box probably has decorations for it 😂
Maya (eng): lol that explains the dog stickers on the crate. Thanks team — I'll meet at reception in 5.
Priya (people-ops): Badge on tray, quiet room reserved, fragile box moved to Meeting Room B. All set.
Alex (People Ops): Kudos to Jordan for sprinting downstairs. :trophy:
Jordan (facilities): Happy to help. Carrying boxes is my cardio.
FrontDeskBot: Thread closed automatically after visitor check-in.
